    def test_path_resolution_error(self):
        import os

        with self.assertRaises(wrapt.PathResolutionError) as cm:
            resolve_path(os, "path.nonexistent_attribute_xyz")

        self.assertIsInstance(cm.exception, AttributeError)
        self.assertIsInstance(cm.exception.__cause__, AttributeError)
        message = str(cm.exception)
        self.assertIn("nonexistent_attribute_xyz", message)
        self.assertIn("path.nonexistent_attribute_xyz", message)
        self.assertIn(repr(os), message)

    def test_target_module_not_found(self):
        with self.assertRaises(wrapt.TargetModuleNotFoundError) as cm:
            resolve_path("no_such_module_xyz", "attr")

        self.assertIsInstance(cm.exception, ModuleNotFoundError)
        self.assertIsInstance(cm.exception.__cause__, ModuleNotFoundError)
        self.assertIn("no_such_module_xyz", str(cm.exception))

    def test_exceptions_exported(self):
        from wrapt import exceptions

        for name in (
            "PathResolutionError",
            "TargetModuleNotFoundError",
            "WrapperNotInitializedError",
        ):
            self.assertIs(getattr(wrapt, name), getattr(exceptions, name))
            self.assertIn(name, wrapt.__all__)
